items.context: Did you receive the bill on Tuesday?
Are you using postpaid or prepaid connection?

items.text: uh I think there is some extra charge added this month
like I paid hundred rupees but bill shows two hundred
umm the call rates looks different from the last month
actually I called customer care last week but no update
I mean the internet usage charges are too high this time
uh I checked my balance and it should not exceed five hundred

items.context: Can you please confirm the disputed amount?
items.text: the bill amount seems wrong by about two hundred rupees

items.context: Did you use any international roaming services recently?
items.text: umm I was not using international roaming this billing cycle

items.context: Please confirm the billing date shown on your statement?
items.text: actually my bill date is twenty third no sorry twenty fourth

items.context: Did you notice any unusual SMS or call charges?
items.text: I found multiple SMS charges though I did not send any
so the bill for this month has almost doubled and I did not change my plan or usage which is quite confusing for me
I mean if you check the data consumption details you will see a large amount of data that I do not recognize from my phone

items.context: Can you describe why you believe the charges are incorrect?
items.text: I think there is a mistake because this bill shows roaming charges but I have not traveled out of my city this month

items.context: Have you contacted customer care before regarding this issue?
items.text: actually I called last week about overcharge but was told to wait which I did now again this bill looks incorrect and I need it fixed please

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: bill_dispute - says a postpaid bill or charge is wrong
Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, uh, like, actually, I mean); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, no, Wednesday')

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
